title: list overlay response
description: Where the backend is linux: standard output of list overlay in JSON mode (LIST-114), or a refusal. The command is the Linux backend's own (overview 2.1), so there is no base or noos shape.

oneOf.description: list overlay (LIST-114), in LIST-113's order; without a compatible, every overlay (LIST-116).

message.description: <n> overlays with <compatible>, or <n> overlays without one (LIST-114, LIST-116).

name.description: The file name, which import and add --template overlay: take.

devices.description: The compatibles of the nodes the overlay adds or changes, as the scan reads them (LIST-110), in file order.

matched.description: The sibling compatible the overlay adds, when it doesn't add the asked one.
